name: step-slider
title: Step slider
description: A slider that snaps to named steps such as Weekly, Monthly and Yearly, with labels under the track and the label spoken as the value.
docs: steps are { value, label, description? } in order, and the knob snaps to equally spaced stops whatever their number; value is the value of the chosen step. A screen reader hears the label and the place ("Monthly, 2 of 3") through aria-valuetext, the arrow keys move one stop, Home and End jump to the ends, and pressing a label chooses its stop. When the container is too narrow for every label (about 3.75rem for each) every other one steps aside, together with the two beside the chosen one, which always stays (with five stops an end label gives way beside the chosen one only below 17.5rem, a little later than the rest). The description of the chosen step shows under the track, and a polite live region reads it out; every description sits in one cell, so nothing moves when the knob does. showLabels={false} leaves the ticks alone and writes the chosen label beside the heading. name sends the chosen value with a plain form.
